The Volume II cover (`images/cover-vol2.png`) is generated
procedurally by the Python script at
`images/build-cover-vol2.py`. Watercolor palette:
deep wine through plum and rose to warm amber, anchored on
burgundy `#7a2c4e`. Typography: Avenir family; body text in
Source Serif 4.

## Chapter selection

The chapter list of the second half was constructed by
surveying 12 publicly available syllabi from major US
biostatistics programs and adopting the topics that appeared
in three or more of them.
